name: Towel Roll Quad Set
steps: Sit on the floor or a firm bed with your target leg extended straight and opposite knee bent.
Place a small rolled towel or washcloth directly under the knee of your target leg.
Tighten your thigh muscles and press the back of your knee firmly down into the towel roll.
Hold the hard isometric quad contraction for 5 full seconds while feeling your kneecap pull upward.
Relax completely for 2 seconds, then repeat for the prescribed repetitions.
coaching_cues: Focus on driving the back of your knee into the towel to activate the vastus medialis oblique.
Do not hold your breath during the 5-second hold; breathe steadily.
Ensure your heel stays in contact with the mat throughout.
